title: MettEagle: Costs and Benefits of Implementing Containers on Microkernels
problem: Container technologies are typically implemented on monolithic kernels; understanding microkernel-based alternatives requires detailed cost-benefit analysis
motivation: Microkernel-based containers could offer better isolation and reliability for AI workloads, but tradeoffs with performance must be understood
method: Comprehensive analysis of implementing container technology on microkernel architectures
key_novelty: First detailed cost-benefit analysis of microkernel-based container implementations
contributions: Comprehensive cost analysis for microkernel containers
Benefit quantification vs monolithic kernel containers
limitations: Title-only paper; specific costs and benefits not quantified; practical applicability unclear
